title: Fuel and engines
note: The fuel a thing burns and its engine and tank: used by appliances, electricity (generators), fuel items, tools and vehicles. A schema picks the fields it needs (uses: "fuel:fuel_type").

fuel_type.note: The fuel it burns (or none). The values differ by category: see each category's own note.

fuel_consumption_l_per_min.note: Liters of fuel burned per IN-GAME minute of running (40 real minutes = 1 in-game day = 1440 in-game minutes at 1x speed). 0 for anything that burns none.

tank_capacity_l.note: Liters of the item's own onboard fuel tank. 0 for everything else.
